description: This Java class 'IntegrationModulesLoader' loads and parses JSON configuration files to create and populate 'IntegrationModule' objects with various configuration details, including module info, settings, regions, and custom attributes.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for loading and parsing JSON configuration files into IntegrationModule objects.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Loads a list of IntegrationModule objects from a JSON file specified by its path.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationModule object from a Map representing JSON data, setting various configuration properties.
